Genomes and genotypic values

Source: R/accessors.R
genomes.Rd

  • genomes(): genomes of the current population, an array rows x alleles x individuals (alleles 2l - 1 and 2l are locus l). Rows are the allelic effect vector (one per trait), or, for binary_b(), y followed by the column of B.

  • genotypic_values(): genotypic values of genomes under an architecture (traits x individuals).

  • local_effects(): effect of each locus of one genome in the background of the rest of the genome (traits x loci): the change in genotypic value when the locus is set to the reference genotype. Equal to the locus effects for the additive architecture.

Usage

genomes(pop)

genotypic_values(x, alleles = genomes(x))

local_effects(x, alleles = genome_of(x, individual), individual = 1)

Arguments

pop

an evomod_population.

x

an architecture, model or population.

alleles

a genome (rows x alleles) or an array of genomes (rows x alleles x individuals), see genomes().

individual

index of an individual of pop.
